# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta10

## Consolidated cumulative runtime

This prerelease promotes the semantic consolidation of the mature 0.3.7-beta9 runtime. It intentionally preserves beta9 behavior while removing redundant runtime wrapper chains and shipping the deterministic minified production build.

- Collapse `_renderHistory` from five wrappers to one canonical dispatcher while preserving artifact, Multi mower, backend current-cycle, archive and legacy daily-history paths.
- Collapse `_applyMapPayload` and `_renderMower` to one wrapper each while retaining payload ordering, stable-cycle handling, mower artwork and error-pulse behavior.
- Reduce safe `setConfig` and `_ensureDom` layers without crossing identity-reset, asynchronous scheduling, resource-lifecycle or feature-UI boundaries.
- Keep Single/Multi mower, Scheduler, History/current cycle, OSM/Google/Estonia underlays, Gate-area editing, vendor/MQTT trails, LiDAR and zone-artifact behavior unchanged.
- Enforce final consolidation limits: 43 patch markers, 50 IIFEs, 8 `setConfig` wrappers, 7 `_ensureDom` wrappers and one wrapper for each prioritized render/payload chain.
- Build `dist/navimower-map-card.js` deterministically with pinned esbuild; the production runtime is about 34% smaller than the readable cumulative source.

The full regression suite, HACS validation and native Chromium artifact tests pass on the consolidated runtime. No configuration migration is required.
